mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling a surge in housing demand, related sectors experience increased activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS, indicating reduced consumer spending, anticipates decreased economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of quarters with declining RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth decelerates (< 100k new jobs per month) and UNRATE rises above 4.5%, a weakening labor market reduces consumption expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in CPIAUCSL, indicating rising consumer prices, erodes purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of CPIAUCSL growth (t-test p > 0.05).
